Fields.Description: Release condition event flag ID

Fields.Name: Bonfire Entity ID
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID

Fields.Name: Sort Order in Subcategory
Fields.Description: Bonfire Warp Subcategory Sort ID. Specify the order (ascending order) in the same subcategory

Fields.Name: Warp Prohibition Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon ID when warp is prohibited

Fields.Name: Display Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The pin is drawn only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). 0: always drawn.

Fields.Name: Selection Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The pin can be selected (and the cursor snaps to it) only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). 0: always.

Fields.Name: Subcategory ID
Fields.Description: Bonfire Warp Subcategory Parameter ID (-1: Invalid). Set which subcategory it belongs to. If it is invalid, it will not be displayed in the bonfire list.

Fields.Name: Cleared Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this event flag is on, the pin shows its "cleared" mark. 0: never shows it.

Fields.Description: Icon ID

Fields.Name: Display Setting M00
Fields.Description: Whether to display with M00

Fields.Name: Show on Underground Map (M01)
Fields.Description: Whether to display with M01

Fields.Description: AA part of mAA_BB_CC_DD

Fields.Name: Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: X

Fields.Name: Text ID [1]
Fields.Description: The text ID to display. If the value is invalid (-1), nothing is displayed.

Fields.Name: Text Enable Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Text 1 is shown only while this event flag is on. Combined with Text Enable Flag ID 2 [1]: every set flag must be on. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Text Disable Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Text 1 is hidden while this event flag is on, overriding the Enable flags. Combined with Text Disable Flag ID 2 [1]: the text is hidden only when every set Disable flag is on. 0: no condition.
